_about: Fifty policies priced by USDA RMA's own PRF tool on 2026-10-12 (scripts/check_prf_rma.mjs, workflow run 38194759287), with the inputs AGSIST priced them from: county base value, the grid's rates at that coverage level, the subsidy rate and that year's index. Nothing under 'rma' was computed by AGSIST. These are the cases that showed the per-acre protection is rounded to the cent and that every dollar rounding is half up; test/prf-math.test.mjs must reproduce every figure.

cases.label: half dollar in the indemnity, odd dollar
